services.name: Schooner Aurora: New England Lobster Boil & Sunset Sail
services.desc: Duration 3 Hours About With her two masts tall under a clear sky, Aurora will take you back to a time reminiscent of the “Tall Ships Era.” The seaworthy Aurora is Coast Guard certified to accommodate up to 68 passengers and is professionally maintained by her friendly and experienced crew Enjoy a true New England Lobster Boil on the Regatta Place patio that includes: 1 ¼ lobster, mussels, corn on the cob, potatoes or your choice of Tuscan Chicken. A Vegetarian option is also available. There is a cash bar during dinner | BYOB on sail What to Bring We require appropriate shoes on the boat.
